video.title: 他把舞鞋换成了镣铐
video.desc:
依旧努力存活
Lex, an illegitimate mafia heir, endures constant abuse in the manor. Gentle ballet teacher Elio brings him warmth, and they grow fond of each other. A cruel conspiracy creates a fatal misunderstanding, making Lex believe Elio betrayed and caused his mother’s death. Filled with hatred, Lex returns six years later as the ruthless mafia boss and imprisons Elio. Amid internal gang turmoil, Lex learns the truth but loses his memory after severe injury. His mind reverts to adolescence, and he reunites and falls for fugitive Elio again. An attack restores Lex’s memory. Haunted by past pain, they go through struggles and repentance, untangle all misunderstandings and gain a happy ending.
Lex 是黑帮的私生子继承人，在庄园中饱受凌虐。温柔的芭蕾老师 Elio 给了他久违的温暖，两人之间渐生情谊。然而一场残酷的阴谋酿成致命误会，让 Lex 深信是 Elio 背叛了他、害死了他的母亲。
六年后，满怀恨意的 Lex 以冷酷黑帮首领的身份归来，将 Elio 囚禁起来。帮派内乱之中，Lex 得知了真相，却在重伤后失去记忆——心智退回到少年时期的他，再次遇见了逃亡中的 Elio，并再一次爱上了他。一场袭击让 Lex 恢复了记忆。
被往日伤痛纠缠的两人，历经挣扎与悔悟，解开所有误会，终得圆满。
